_readme: Structural definitions for Aurelia Academy: facilities, dorm capacity table, study focuses, majors, club roles, Director origins, Director active roles, and Executive Protocols.

classrooms.name: Academic Hall
classrooms.effect: Boosts Morning lecture skill gains and Academic Prestige.

gym.name: Athletic Center
gym.effect: Boosts PE & Intimacy physical conditioning, security power, and unlocks Security role at Tier 3.

salon.name: Beauty Salon
salon.effect: Boosts Afternoon specialization gains (Performance, Seduction, Socialite) and Social Refinement.

living_standards.name: Living Standards
living_standards.effect: Increases nightly fatigue recovery for all enrolled students.

nightclub.name: Nightfall Club
nightclub.effect: Increases patron volume & club quality. Unlocks Lv1 Hostess/Bartender, Lv2 Dancer, Lv3 Singer, Lv4 Private Service.

bureau.name: Intelligence Bureau
bureau.effect: Raises incoming applicant quality and reveals deeper dossier insight.

Intimacy.label: Intimacy Workshop
Intimacy.desc: Trains Vaginal Service, Anal Service, and Fitness.

Service.label: Service Practicum
Service.desc: Trains Manual Service, Oral Service, and Bartending.

Rest.label: Infirmary & Rest
Rest.desc: Skips study to recover fatigue and calm arousal.

None.label: Off Duty (Rest)
None.desc: Takes the evening off to recover fatigue.

Hostess.label: Hostess
Hostess.desc: Entertains patrons with conversation, charm, and flirting at VIP booths.

Bartender.label: Bartender
Bartender.desc: Runs cocktail service and boosts tips across the club floor.

Dancer.label: Dancer
Dancer.desc: Performs spotlight routines that raise Social Refinement and patron draw.

Singer.label: Singer
Singer.desc: Commands the main stage, lifting Refinement and VIP booth generosity.

Security.label: Security
Security.desc: Polices the VIP floor and prevents costly City Infamy incidents.

Private_Service.label: Private Service
Private_Service.desc: Provides private VIP room services (Massage, Manual, Oral, Vaginal, Anal).

backgrounds.name: Disgraced Academic
backgrounds.description: A former dean who knows the curriculum inside out. +15 Intelligence, +10% Knowledge growth academy-wide.

backgrounds.name: Former Fixer
backgrounds.description: You dealt with the city's shadowed syndicate. +15 Physicality, +20% Security power & Compliance growth.

backgrounds.name: Disowned Heir
backgrounds.description: Fallen from grace, manners intact. +15 Social, +15% Etiquette growth & +10% club tips.

Academic.label: Academic Dean
Academic.desc: Your Intelligence provides +50% more bonus to all study gains.

Manager.label: Club Manager
Manager.desc: Hostesses and Private Service earn +25% base revenue.

Recruiter.label: Head Recruiter
Recruiter.desc: +15 Applicant quality and +4 candidates per queue.

protocols.name: Walking the Halls
protocols.effect: All students gain +1.5 Compliance and +3.0 Arousal during daytime/evening shifts.

protocols.name: Lead Academic Seminar
protocols.effect: Grants extra skill gains (+3.5 base) to all studying students and boosts Academic Prestige.

protocols.name: City Consulting
protocols.effect: Earn off-site consulting funds scaled by your Intelligence and Academic Prestige.

protocols.name: Targeted Counseling
protocols.effect: Reduces one student's fatigue by 28 and raises her Compliance by +5.

protocols.name: VIP Filtering
protocols.effect: Screens Evening patrons: +35% tips, +1 VIP/Hostess patron, and -35% incident risk.

protocols.name: Intimate Guidance
protocols.effect: Private one-on-one session: +8 Lust, +7 Compliance, +5 Seduction, +20 Arousal, +3 Depravity.
